# qwen-flash-1 — died in the town

> **Reconstructed, not written by the player.** This run finished without writing a report: it reported to the session that started it, and that account lived in a conversation rather than in the repository. What follows was written afterwards from the run's own record, decisions and notebook, plus the player's handback where there was one. The player's own words are only in `notebook.md`.

73 asks, 204 keypresses, turn 570. High-Elf Druid, **depth 0**, character
level 1, **killed on level 0 by a scruffy little dog**. Played through
OpenCode on `alibaba-token-plan/qwen3.8-flash`, 41.9 seconds a decision.

## What happened

It never left the town. Twenty-nine of its 73 asks went on birth and
shopping; the rest were spent walking around the town until a scruffy little
dog killed a 12 hit point Druid.

## What it is evidence for

- **A model can read the knowledge and still not play.** It had the same
  manual pages and the same notes as the runs that reached depth 6 and 7.
- **Word of Recall does nothing useful from the town.** It read one and held
  for about forty turns waiting for a teleport. Its own note hedged - "either
  it resolves at the next transition or..." - and the source later settled it:
  recall from the town goes to depth 1, but the counter ticks once every ten
  game turns, so the wait is 150-340 game turns and it gave up at a quarter of
  the minimum.
- **A `-more-` eats the first key of the next string.** One of the few things
  it confirmed independently, and it matches what two other runs found.

68 notebook lines about a game it never played past the gate.
